title: A call for broadening the altmetrics tent to democratize science outreach
content:
by Ivan Jarić, Pavel Pipek, Ana Novoa

Common altmetrics indices are limited and biased in the social media that they cover. In this Perspective, we highlight how and why altmetrics should broaden its scope to provide more reliable metrics for scientific content and communication.
